what_it_shows: Rightmove property-type filter: 68 residential types in one flat list (Terraced, Semi-Detached, Detached, Flat, Maisonette, Penthouse, Bungalow variants, Land, Plot, House Boat, Park Home, Mobile Home, Caravan, Garages, Parking, Riad, Trulli, Finca, Cave House, Castle); Bungalow kept out of Detached/Semi/Terraced searches; Land split into Land, Farm Land and Commercial land

Census 2021 accommodation type: whole house or bungalow (detached, semi-detached, terraced incl. end/mid-terrace) vs flat/maisonette/apartment (purpose-built block, converted house, converted other building, commercial building) vs caravan or other mobile or temporary structure; 8 categories, first asked 1981

SUUMO search form: property type choice is four values - new detached house, used detached house, used condominium (mansion), land - with price, floor plan, walking time and building age as further filters

LandWatch facets: Property Types (Undeveloped, Homesite, House, Waterfront, Lakefront, Farms and Ranches, Recreational, Commercial), Land Uses (Homestead, Hobby Farm, Orchard, Pasture, Vineyard, Poultry Farm), Housing Type (Guest House, Mobile Home, Barndominium, Cottage, Tiny Home, Cabin, Lake House), Parcel Size bands, Geography (Mountain, Off Grid, Riverfront...)

realestate.com.au help: House (stand-alone, individual title), Townhouse (may share walls, strata title), Apartment (strata); 'Unit' grouped with Apartment in filters; division rests on building form and title

Dunster House (garden-building maker-retailer) navigation: Log Cabins, Summerhouses, Garden Offices, Sheds, Greenhouses, Gazebos and Pergolas, Conservatory Alternatives (Addroom), Porches and Canopies, Garages and Carports, Pub Sheds and Garden Bars; structure types Wooden Gazebos, Pergolas, Arbours and Arches

Six tiny-home types (on wheels, park model, modular, panelized kit, HUD-code manufactured, site-built under IRC Appendix Q); category set by the building code it is built to, which decides placement, financing and insurance; container homes are a material choice not a code category

PlotListings: seven interment options - single plot, companion (double) plot, family plot, lawn crypt, mausoleum crypt, private mausoleum, cremation niche - with capacity, location (in-ground or above-ground) and price ranges; decision order burial or cremation, above or in ground, number of people

Dignity Memorial: cemetery property split into in-ground (individual plots single or double depth, private estates gated or hedge, lawn crypts) and aboveground (community mausoleums, private mausoleums, columbaria); also cremation gardens and scattering gardens

German grave types: Wahlgrab (site chosen, extendable; Einzeltiefgrab up to 2 coffins, Mehrfachwahlgrab up to 4, called Familiengrab), Reihengrab (assigned in sequence, rest period not extendable), anonymous grave; alternatives Baumgrab, Gruft, Roese, Urnenstele, Kolumbarium, Felsengrab, Rasengrab

idealista guide: vivienda unifamiliar (adosada, pareada, aislada; chalet, casa, masia, cortijo, casona) vs plurifamiliar (piso, apartamento, duplex, triplex, atico, estudio, loft); first cut is one family vs several

Von Poll Immobilien (Germany) listing page fetched through Parallel; excerpt returned only schema.org JSON-LD tagging listings as SingleFamilyResidence; the Objektarten filter list did not come through (WebFetch refused with 403), so no German portal facet list is used as evidence

SeLoger home: types de biens listed as Appartements, Maisons, Chateaux, Fermes, Hotels particuliers, Lofts, Studios, Parkings, Terrains, Viagers, Bureaux; maison filters include plain-pied, avec piscine, avec jardin

ACS table B25024 Units in Structure: 1 detached, 1 attached, 2, 3 or 4, 5 to 9, 10 to 19, 20 to 49, 50 or more, Mobile home, Boat/RV/van etc.; housing units are binned by number of units in the structure

Japan Housing and Land Survey 2023 terms: dwelling defined by room, sink, toilet and entrance; type of building = detached house, tenement-house (incl. terrace houses), apartment, others; separate tenure, construction material and storeys fields; land use of site and parking buildings also defined

Wikipedia list of house types: basic division free-standing detached vs attached or multi-family; sections for housebarn, hut, cottage, courtyard house (riad), by construction method (log, prefab, modular, container), single-family attached, movable dwellings (mobile home or park home, RV, tiny house, houseboat, tent, yurt, tipi)

FISH Thesaurus of Monument Types (Historic England standard): 18 top concepts including Domestic, Agriculture and Subsistence, Religious Ritual and Funerary, Recreational, Commercial, Industrial, Transport, Defence - heritage records classify buildings by function

Historic England National Farm Building Types: terminology for ~30 farm building kinds (barn, cart shed, granary, hay barn, stable, staddle barn, Dutch barn, dovecote, coach house, kennels, mill, malt house, well house...) incorporated into the FISH thesaurus
Bunnings Sheds category: Garages and Carports, Shed Accessories and Attachments, Garden Sheds, Small Garden Sheds, Outbuildings; filters weight, colour, volume

Hornbach Gartenhaeuser und Carports: Gartenhaeuser, Carports, Pavillons, Aussensauna, Fahrradgaragen, Muelltonnenboxen, Gartenschraenke, Vordaecher; filters Ausfuehrung (Anstellpavillon) and Artikeltyp (Bausatz, Bar); buying guide frames a garden house as extra room (tool store, hobby room, workplace, guest house)

Static caravan (BS EN 1647 leisure standard, holiday licence), holiday lodge (usually EN 1647, some BS 3632, leisure licence), park home (BS 3632 residential standard, residential licence, Mobile Homes Act); lodge up to 20m by 6.8m is legally still a caravan

UK land agent: land sold by use - agricultural (arable, pasture), grazing, paddock (about one acre per horse), recreational, smallholding (1-50 acres), woodland, strategic land; Agricultural Land Classification grades measure quality

REINZ property type definitions: residential (House, Section, Apartment, Unit, Townhouse, Conversion, Home and income, Residential investment block) and rural (Lifestyle Blocks, Arable, Dairy, Dairy Support, Grazing, Horticulture, Forestry, Special)

PGG Wrightson rural search: farm types Bare Land, Cropping, Dairy, Deer, Finishing, Forestry, Grazing, High Country, Horticulture, Lifestyle Bare Land, Lifestyle with Dwelling, Sheep/Beef, Specialist, Viticulture; land-area bands

Australian Land Use and Management Classification v8: six primary classes - conservation and natural environments, production from relatively natural environments, dryland agriculture and plantations, irrigated agriculture and plantations, intensive uses, water; commodity and management practice fields refine within a class

Japanese grave types: ippan-bo (stone family grave; wagata, yogata, gorinto, design), jumokuso (tree burial, first 1999 Ichinoseki), nokotsudo (indoor hall: locker, butsudan, ihai and automated types), gōshi-bo (communal grave); eitai kuyo is a contract service, not a grave form

LandSale UK: land sold by type - House with Land, Farmland, Recreational, Island, Barn Conversion, Farmhouse, Barn, Fishery, Building Plot, Lake, Solar Farm, Vineyard, Estate, Timberland, Stable, Field, Orchard, Cave, Grazing Land, Allotment, Outbuilding, Annexe, Shepherd's Hut, Dairy Farm, Country Estate; over 100 types
Australian rural agent: lifestyle farm (5-10 acres, not main income), weekender or retreat, working farm (100+ acres, main income), self-sufficient property

Zillow guide: 27 home types (ADU, condo, floating home, houseboat, mobile home, modular, motor home, prefab, single-family, tiny home, townhouse...); says home type is the building structure and house style is the architecture; mobile vs manufactured home split at HUD 15 June 1976

Houseboat guide: four families - pontoon, trailerable, full-displacement cruising, floating homes that do not move; houseboat (registered vessel with propulsion) vs floating home (no propulsion, taxed and financed like real estate); size classes and cost table; builders Stardust, Sumerset, Gibson, Fantasy, Lakeview

Seattle local terms: floating home (owned, co-op or condo slip, permanent utilities) vs FOWR floating-on-water residence (boat-like, leased slip, pumped sewage) vs house barge (no motor); 507 floating homes, 215 FOWRs
Floating home (no motor, concrete hull, permanent utilities, sold with slip, real-estate-like) vs houseboat (fiberglass, steel or aluminium hull, self-propelled, boat loan); cost ranges
Three inground pool types - fiberglass shell, vinyl liner, concrete (gunite) - compared on install time, upfront cost, upkeep and customisation; shells made by a manufacturer sold through dealers
Pool dealer: three primary inground types (fiberglass preformed shell, vinyl liner on site-built walls, gunite formed on site) by manufacture method, flexibility, surface and care

Chinese property encyclopedia: housing types by planning feature - ordinary dwelling (under 140 sqm), apartment-style, townhouse (lianpai), garden house (huayuan yangfang), small detached, duplex, split-level; and by build form - slab block, tower, mixed

Chinese seven building types: detached villa (dudong), twin villa (shuangpin), townhouse villa (lianpai, 3+ units sharing side walls), stacked villa (diepin), office tower (Grade A and 5A rating standards), slab block, tower block
